settings.title: How to use it?
settings.content:
• Prepare – Cleanse with our organic Mangosteen Cleanser and apply Restore or Renu conductive gel to the face and neck.
  • Select Settings – Turn on the MyoLift Triwave and adjust the intensity to your comfort level. Choose the Rejuv setting for detoxification.
  • Lymphatic Drainage – Use gentle, sweeping motions along the lymphatic pathways to reduce puffiness and promote toxin removal.
  • Slide & Glide – Move the probes gently over targeted areas such as the forehead, cheeks, jawline, and neck, following the training guide.
  • Pinch & Hold – For deeper lifting, hold the probes on areas prone to sagging for added definition.
  • Finish – Rinse off any remaining gel and apply our Anti-Aging Serum or Revital-C Serum.
  • Recommended Use – 1-3 times per week until desired results are reached. This can take weeks or months depending on your age and the condition of your skin.

settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.title1: What makes the MyoLift Triwave different from other microcurrent devices?
settings.text1: The MyoLift Triwave is a professional-grade microcurrent device that offers three distinct waveforms—Erase, Educate, and Rejuvenate—each waveform is designed to target specific skin concerns. This versatile device allows for deeper muscle re-education, enhanced facial toning, and improved skin rejuvenation compared to single-waveform devices.
settings.title2: Can the MyoLift Triwave be used for both home and professional treatments?
settings.text2: Yes, the MyoLift Triwave is designed for both professional estheticians and advanced home users. It provides salon-quality results, and it is also user-friendly enough for at-home treatments, allowing for flexibility depending on your needs.
settings.title3: How do the different waveforms (Erase, Educate, Rejuv) work?
settings.text3:
Erase: Targets fine lines and wrinkles by relaxing facial muscles to smooth the skin.

Educate: Re-educates and strengthens facial muscles, providing lift and improved tone

Rejuv: has a  specifically designed pumping waveform to stimulate the lymphatic system and promote drainage.
settings.title4: What are the benefits of Lymphatic drainage when combined with microcurrent?
settings.text4:
Combining lymphatic drainage with microcurrent therapy amplifies the benefits of both treatments, offering a range of advantages for skin health and overall wellness.

Enhanced Detoxification: Lymphatic drainage helps remove toxins and waste products from the body. When paired with microcurrent therapy, which stimulates cellular activity, the detoxification process becomes more efficient, leading to clearer skin and improved overall health.

Reduced Puffiness and Inflammation: The gentle movements of lymphatic drainage help to reduce fluid retention and swelling. When combined with microcurrent therapy, this effect is intensified, leading to a more sculpted facial appearance and reduced inflammation, particularly in the under-eye and jawline areas. 

Improved Skin Tone and Texture: Microcurrent therapy promotes collagen and elastin production while lymphatic drainage enhances circulation. Together, they improve skin tone and texture, leading to a more youthful and radiant complexion.

Increased Oxygen and Nutrient Delivery: Microcurrent therapy boosts blood circulation, which, when combined with lymphatic drainage, enhances the delivery of oxygen and nutrients to skin cells. This results in healthier skin that appears revitalized and rejuvenated.
settings.title5: Which Waveform should I start with when using the Myolift Triwave?
settings.text5:
Rejuv: Start with lymphatic drainage, reducing puffiness and enhancing skin rejuvenation.

Erase: Targets fine lines and wrinkles, relaxing facial muscles.

Educate: Focuses on re-educating and strengthening the facial muscles for a toned appearance.
